F1.note: Removes resolveProfileActivitySelection's FORBIDDEN guard, so a saved foreign owner filter no longer makes the sidebar list fail.

F2.note: SessionOwnerFilter.read now resets a restored foreign owner filter to involvingMe on each authenticated hello when the viewer is restricted, recovering stale sidebar filters after role changes.

F3.note: peopleSessionCount now increments for every readable session instead of only those associated with the guest.

F4.note: The foreign-filter FORBIDDEN path is removed entirely, so the empty-vs-forbidden distinction that leaked hidden sessions no longer exists.

F5.note: The person-privacy guard that compared every ownerId to the viewer profile is deleted, so agent owner filters are accepted.

F6.note: Guard deleted and owner facet now adds every effective owner of readable sessions, restoring agent owner/creator filters and facet options.
